title: CROSS-MORSE: Cross-Spectral Control of Message Passing in Frozen Graph Neural Networks (reference implementation)
description: CROSS-MORSE reference implementation for inference-time control of frozen graph neural networks. Includes seven dataset adapters, 21 configurations, experiment and Slurm drivers, tests, environment specifications, two complete synthetic examples, and artifact-based reconstruction tools. The CPU execution package and the original-paper artifact distribution have separate manifests. AVAILABILITY.md records the resources, execution scopes and verification requirements; demo/RESULTS.md records the CPU reconstruction coverage and comparisons. Companion manuscript under review.
